summary: TransCanada PipeLines Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing Exhibit 99.1, an unaudited schedule of earnings coverage calculations for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, prepared under US GAAP and filed in connection with its Form F-10 shelf registration. Earnings from continuing operations before interest and taxes of approximately $8.562 billion covered interest obligations of approximately $3.418 billion at 2.5 times. The filing is a routine supplemental financial disclosure with no transaction terms, no board recommendation, and no advisory mandate; no deal-related mechanics or regulatory clocks apply.
